sentences.en: Your examples are cherry-picked, nothing more than anecdotal evidence.
sentences.zh: 你提供的例子都是挑拣出来的，充其量只是轶闻证据。

sentences.en: His argument was based entirely on anecdotal evidence.
sentences.zh: 他的论据完全基于轶闻证据。

sentences.en: The four books already mentioned, Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John, are altogether anecdotal.
sentences.zh: 前面提到的四本书，马太、马可、路加和约翰，都是轶闻性质的。

senses.zh: 轶事的,趣闻的,多轶事的,含轶事的
